nodes.label: Clear Icon (Broom/Sweep)
nodes.description: A small icon depicting a yellow broom/whisk-broom with a wooden handle and purple band, sweeping a small dust particle. Represents the 'clear' action — used in UI to clear input fields, search results, history, or selections.
nodes.ui_purpose: Button or icon to clear/reset content (e.g., clear search box, clear selection, clear results)

nodes.label: Clear Action
nodes.rationale: The broom metaphor is a common UI convention to convey 'sweeping away' content — clearing inputs, resetting state, or removing items. Chosen over a trash/delete icon because clearing is non-destructive (resets a view) rather than permanently destroying data.
